title: Snow White and the seven dwarfs.
lines: Once upon a time there was a little princess.
Her skin was as white as snow, her cheeks as red as an apple and her hair as black as the night.
That's why she was called Snow White.
Snow White lived in a big castle.
But she had a stepmother, the queen.
The queen was very beautiful, but also very jealous.
She had a magic mirror on the wall.
Every day she asked: Mirror, mirror on the wall, who is the fairest of them all?
And the mirror always said: You, my queen, are the fairest of them all.
But one day the mirror said something else.
Snow White is now the fairest of them all.
The queen was furious.
Snow White must go!
she shouted.
A hunter had to take Snow White into the dark forest.
But the hunter had a good heart.
Run away, child, he said.
Run far away and never come back.
Snow White walked through the forest.
It was dark and the branches looked like arms.
She was scared.
But the animals of the forest helped her.
A bunny, a little deer and some birds showed her the way.
And so she came to a tiny little house.
Everything in it was small.
Seven little chairs.
Seven little plates.
Seven little beds.
Snow White was so tired that she fell asleep on the little beds.
That evening the people who lived there came home.
They were seven dwarfs!
They worked all day in the mountains, looking for precious stones.
Each of them wore a pointy hat and they had long beards.
Hey, who's sleeping in our beds?
they asked.
Snow White woke up and told them her story.
You can stay with us, said the dwarfs.
But never open the door to strangers!
Snow White was happy.
She cooked tasty soup.
She sang songs.
And the dwarfs whistled as they went off to work.
But the queen asked her mirror again: Who is the fairest of them all?
And the mirror said: Snow White, in the little house of the seven dwarfs.
The queen got even angrier.
She dressed up as an old woman.
She took a beautiful red apple.
But it was a magic apple.
Whoever bit into it fell into a deep sleep.
Knock, knock.
Sweet child, said the old woman.
Would you like an apple?
Snow White knew she wasn't allowed to open the door.
But the woman seemed so friendly.
She took the apple and bit into it.
And right away she fell into a deep sleep.
When the dwarfs came home, they were very sad.
They made a beautiful bed of glass and laid Snow White in it, with flowers all around.
Every day they came to sit with her.
One day a prince came by on his white horse.
He saw Snow White and thought she was the sweetest princess he had ever seen.
When the dwarfs lifted the glass bed, one of them tripped.
Bonk!
And the piece of apple fell out of Snow White's mouth.
She opened her eyes.
Where am I?
she asked.
With us!
shouted the dwarfs.
They danced with joy.
The queen asked her mirror one more time who was the fairest.
When the mirror gave the answer, it broke into a thousand pieces.
The queen ran away and was never seen again.
Snow White and the prince threw a big party.
Of course the seven dwarfs were there too.
And they lived happily ever after.
The end.
